en-US.longDescription: Validator And Line-Verified Export Tool. Load BOM and PnP files, clean component names, cross-check, merge, and export. The Windows package is a PyInstaller onedir zip (Qt DLLs next to VALVET.exe). ACE ODBC, pythonocc, and repo example fixtures are not bundled.
en-US.name: VALVET
en-US.releaseNotes: BETA v0.5.3.0 Windows onedir zip (PyInstaller). Qt DLLs live next to VALVET.exe. ACE ODBC and pythonocc are not bundled. SHA256 is in the job log. Optional: gh attestation verify VALVET-0.5.3.0-windows-x64.zip --repo zhoel-sherk/VALVET
